selectionSummary: Seven complete supplied Chinese manuscripts were independently checked and edited; none is replaced with a brief. Seven source-selected image candidates were reviewed separately; image substitutions do not exclude a story.

heldCandidates.subject: Leidos AI agent supervision platform
heldCandidates.reason: Only vendor claims were available for cross-provider control and credential-protection effects, without independent deployment or performance evidence; the topic substantially overlaps recent AI-agent-control coverage.

factualCorrections.correction: The July–September moving-average trade deficit is compared with the June–August moving average, not an earlier non-overlapping quarter or the previous release vintage.

The 28.2 and 31.7 billion dollar finance estimates reflect AGR and OECD methods. Only OECD rises about 1 billion year on year; AGR uses commitments and a 2024-price series that falls. The 305 billion dollar needs figure is in 2024 prices; with assumed 3% annual inflation it is about 420 billion in 2035. The 85–120 billion scenario therefore covers 20–29%; tripling means reaching three times baseline, not adding 300%.

scopeReview: No selected subject concerns One-China, Taiwan sovereignty, cross-strait political disputes or a substantively equivalent dispute. Humanitarian, medical, ordinary technology and business topics are not categorically excluded.

deduplication.comparison: Source URLs, event/data periods and topics checked against current main publication log and formal-domain article data. No same-event republication found. Shared license URLs are not news-event duplicates.

mediaReview: See the issue media provenance and candidate audit for pixel inspection, licensing, precise archival captions, privacy sanitization and substitutions.
verificationStatus: Final publishing-derivative candidate passed all 188 automated tests, production-origin build, TypeScript/lint, static export and SEO checks. The seven subjects are present in all five languages (35 editions). Production deployment, exact deployed commit and real desktop/mobile browser acceptance remain pending; local checks are not evidence of publication.

localVerification.publishingDerivativeMetadata: All five resized JPEGs match recorded file hashes, dimensions, byte counts and Pillow-decoded RGB hashes. Nonessential EXIF/IPTC/XMP are absent; original ICC profiles match. All five JPEGs and their largest AVIF derivatives were visually inspected at full frame.
